title: Making Something From Nothing: Invention or Discovery?
summary: A translation of the same day's philosophy episode, debating whether creativity genuinely brings something new into being or merely finds and recombines what already exists; it sets the Platonic idea of creation as recollection and inspiration against the notion of the imaginative faculty in Islamic thought (al-Fārābī, Ibn ʿArabī), the Romantic cult of genius, and combinatorial accounts of novelty.
